Category filter is bioinformatics, genomics, synthetic biology, systems biology, pharmacology, or bioengineering for bioRxiv, and clinical categories with a therapy or trial word for medRxiv, plus AI-method titles.

BioCatalystFeed Worker /papers, which proxies the Europe PMC search API. Same metadata terms as a direct Europe PMC call. Titles that assert efficacy are skipped. Duplicate DOIs collapse with the direct Europe PMC source.

BioCatalystFeed Worker /ai-discovery. Curated model cards are included only when verified_as_of or published falls in the last 45 days. arXiv rows come from the worker's allowlisted category query and are labeled as preprints. Summaries are not copied. No X client is called.

NIH RePORTER project search for titles matching gene therapy, cell therapy, monoclonal antibody, CRISPR, drug discovery with a project start from 2026-09-03 to 2026-11-17. SEC EDGAR daily index Form 8-K rows for 129 tickers already listed in calendar/calendar.json. 6 index days were not posted (403 or 404), which is how SEC answers for a weekend, a holiday, or a file that is not up yet.
